title: I gave AI a riddle with the answer IN it

beats.big:
The answer
is IN the
question.
beats.say: I gave AI a riddle with the answer right in the question.
You know the old one. A boy is rushed to surgery. The surgeon says, I can't operate, he's my son.
The answer? The surgeon is his mom.

beats.big:
New version:
"The surgeon
is his DAD."
beats.say: So researchers changed it. They said it outright. The surgeon is the boy's father.
Then they asked: who is the surgeon?
Some AI models still answered. His mother.

beats.big:
It knew
the riddle.
Not the facts.
beats.say: A Mount Sinai study found the AI clung to the riddle it had memorized, and ignored what it was told.
Follow for more things the algorithm did.
